summary: Tested Parkview Counseling kiosk backend (7/7 pytest cases pass) and frontend (full check-in flow works in browser automation). Backend: /api/therapists returns exactly 3 expected therapists with no emails leaked; refresh=true returns source 'live'; second call returns 'cache'; /api/checkin with rich-maier returns 200 with test_mode=true, therapist_name 'Rich Maier' and 'EDT' timestamp; unknown slug returns 422 with detail.code='NO_EMAIL_MAPPING'; /api/admin/failures lists NO_EMAIL_MAPPING entry. Frontend: home screen with header, 3 therapist cards visible by data-testid, confirm modal shows 'Check in with Rich Maier?', cancel returns home, confirm shows success screen with 'Thank you!' + '[Name] has been notified.' + 'Check in Another Client' button; clicking returns home.
critical_code_review_comments: send_checkin_email: when Resend call fails it raises generic Exception caught and surfaced as 502; consider mapping Resend error fields for clearer operator logs (low priority).
FAILURE_LOG is in-memory only (max 200) and resets on backend restart; acceptable for MVP but worth persisting if practice needs historical audit.
/api/admin/failures has no auth and is intentionally public per problem statement; before production, gate behind a simple token to avoid leaking slug/error info.
seed_data_creation: None - therapists are scraped live from parkviewcounseling.org.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_kiosk_api.py covers all required endpoints. The 12s success auto-return was not waited out in playwright (would extend run time); the timer logic is straightforward in Kiosk.jsx (setTimeout SUCCESS_RETURN_MS=12000 inside useEffect on screen change). Resend keys intentionally absent -> test_mode=true is expected behaviour, not a bug.
